data.name: AlHalima
data.gender_notes: AlHalima is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Al-Halima means 'the one who protects'. This name is derived from the Arabic root h-l-m, which translates to 'shelter' or 'protect'. In Islamic history, Al-Halima bint Al-Akhtar was a renowned companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who showed great compassion and hospitality to the Prophet during his early years in Mecca.
data.spiritual_meaning: A protector and guardian of faith.
data.etymology: AlHalima belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The one who protects.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHalima total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
